set_aside.subject: R0-24 identity boundary
set_aside.text: Registry becomes the platform's trusted entry point: it keeps identity (project, customer, object, rooms, artifact pointers)
set_aside.question: Does “identity” here exclude an identity for Object, so that Object is only embedded project data with no independently nameable identifier?
options: Object is embedded in Project and has no identity of its own
Object remains an independently identified entity
set_aside.default_guess: Treat Object as embedded project data with no identity of its own, following R0-86.

set_aside.subject: R0-34 import links
set_aside.text: it keeps its links: customer, object, rooms, pointers
set_aside.question: What does keeping an Object “link” mean when R0-86 says the Object is part of the Project and has no identity of its own?
options: Import the Object inline as part of its Project; there is no Object link
Model a separate Object relationship despite the lack of a caller-visible id
set_aside.default_guess: Import the Object inline and treat “object” in this list of links as stale wording.

set_aside.subject: import projects with their identity
set_aside.text: those projects under the identities they carry, with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept), links intact
set_aside.question: Which listed items does “ids kept” cover, and is Object imported inline rather than as an identified linked record?
options: Keep project, room and pointer ids and minted customer_ref values; carry Object inline
Keep an Object id or Object link as well
set_aside.default_guess: Exclude Object from “ids kept” and carry it inline within its Project.

set_aside.subject: erase an archived project output
set_aside.text: the project anonymised — its id, status and artifact pointers stay, its name, object and customer link go
set_aside.question: Must the observable result of anonymisation also include or otherwise account for the retained anonymised mark introduced by R0-87?
options: The mark is retained internal state but is not returned by this action
The action returns the retained mark
The mark is observable only through later erased responses
set_aside.default_guess: Retain the mark as internal state and use it to produce the already specified erased responses and deletion refusal.

set_aside.subject: R0-60 anonymised-project retention
set_aside.text: anonymised (id, status and pointers stay, name, object and customer link go; `validate` answers `archived`)
set_aside.question: Is the anonymised mark also part of the state retained by this action, despite being omitted from this stated retained set?
options: Retain id, status, anonymised mark and pointers
Retain only id, status and pointers
set_aside.default_guess: Retain the anonymised mark as required by R0-87.

set_aside.subject: R0-87 anonymisation chronology
set_aside.text: When it was archived and when it was anonymised, the audit log says.
set_aside.question: After the owner erases old audit entries under R0-66, must Registry still be able to say when the project was archived and anonymised, and if so where are those dates retained?
options: The dates are available only while their audit entries remain
The project retains the dates separately from the erasable audit log
Relevant audit entries cannot be erased
set_aside.default_guess: Treat the dates as available through the audit log only for as long as those entries are retained.
